acf.s093_p: Holding a real estate share in Grenada can be more than an investment intended to generate income and a store of value held in US dollars. A share in InterContinental Grenada Resort — a project approved by the Government of Grenada — also opens a route to citizenship for life for your whole family, with no residence requirement.
acf.s096_p: If you invest in a qualifying project, you can apply for Grenadian citizenship under Grenada's Citizenship by Investment program.
acf.s098_p: Grenadian citizenship is granted for life if the Government of Grenada approves your application.
acf.s100_p: Your family can be included in the same application, within the range of dependents the program allows at the time you apply.
acf.s102_p: Grenada allows dual or multiple citizenship, so you can keep your current citizenship if the laws of that country allow it.
acf.s103_li: IMM Group is the first and only company in Vietnam authorized by the Government of Grenada to market the Grenada Citizenship by Investment program
acf.s104_li: IMM Group helps prepare your application and represents your interests throughout the process.
acf.s110_li: You and your family can receive Grenadian citizenship and passports if your application is approved.
acf.s111_li: The Grenadian passport offers convenient travel access to more than 140 countries and territories, including much of Europe, the United Kingdom, China, and Hong Kong.
acf.s112_li: There is no requirement to live in Grenada to keep your citizenship.
acf.s113_li: The whole process can be completed from your country of residence.
acf.s117_li: The main applicant must be 18 or older.
acf.s118_li: You must be in good health, have no criminal record, and have enough lawfully sourced funds to make the investment.
acf.s119_li: The application goes through due diligence and background checks and is assessed by the Government of Grenada.
acf.s123_li: The projected return is about 4% a year over 5 years — roughly US$54,000 in total.
acf.s124_li: Under the project terms, the return is paid after your citizenship application is approved and you have completed 100% of the investment.
acf.s125_li: This is a projected return based on the project documents and contract; actual results depend on construction progress, the resort's operating performance, market conditions, and the terms you sign.
acf.s129_li: Investors receive 7 complimentary nights a year at the resort for 5 years, as set out in the project documents.
acf.s130_li: Use of the resort benefit is subject to the project's rules and operating calendar.
